decision: Model the Binance incident by asset, chain, wallet, custody/issuer authority, reserve status, transaction disposition and observation cutoff. Never transfer a reserve-wallet finding from one chain/asset to another.
rationale: The incident includes native XRP, ETH, BTC, USDT, USDC, RLUSD, USD1 and DeFi collateral. Native XRP cannot be issuer-frozen, while issued stablecoins may be frozen by their issuers. CoinDesk's Binance 14 PoR finding is Ethereum-specific; the five compromised XRPL source wallets remain unidentified. ETF aggregators also mix spot, derivative and index products.
feature_policy: Do not admit the 233.46M XRP transfer, Binance PoR ratios, ETF aggregates or stale OKX quote as predictive features until wallet crosswalk, point-in-time timestamps, product universe, synchronized market data and source-quality checks pass. Maintain NOT_ISSUED until a leakage-safe fixed-horizon model is calibrated and shadow-evaluated.
